Method.description: a technique, model or algorithm the paper names

Condition.description: a premise the claim depends on

Limitation.description: a bound on validity or scope

Finding.description: a reported result as a node so it can be queried

uses.description: the source approach contains the target

evaluated-on.description: the source is measured on the target task

reports.description: the source reports the target metric

compared-with.description: evaluated under the same conditions, no direction

improves-on.description: the source is a modification that raises performance

requires.description: the source holds only when the target holds

trained-on.description: the source's parameters are learned from the target

supports.description: the finding is evidence about the method

causes.description: the source is reported as the cause of the target

from-paper.description: provenance link to the source publication

evidence.note: quote must occur verbatim in the parsed paper; anchor is p<page>b<block>
